'''Nozomu Sasaki''' (Japanese: '''佐々木望''' ''Sasaki Nozomu'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Nozomu was born on January 25, 1967, in {{wp|Hiroshima}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and become a voice actor and singer as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where he voiced {{an|Sophocles}}'s [[rival]] [[Horacio]]. Nozomu is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}.
